changelog: The configuration page in 1.0.70.0 was blank, and this makes it appear. The new page waited for an event this dashboard does not send - it listened for viewshow, while the page it replaced had listened for pageshow for seventy releases - so the handler that loads the app never ran, no script tag was ever made, and the notice that exists to say the app is missing could not fire either. It now listens for both names, because a lifecycle whose name changed between versions has to be met halfway. A second fault behind that one is fixed at the same time: a module is evaluated once per document, so leaving the page and coming back would have re-added a script tag that never ran, and the page would have worked exactly once. Each visit now loads under its own query string and Svelte takes the previous one down properly. The link to the previous configuration page is gone; it never worked, for the same reason nothing else on the page did.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
